tasks.prompt: The daily sales report is slow. Add an index on orders.created_at in a new migration under migrations/.

cmd:
import re, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *args], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
base = git("rev-list", "--max-parents=0", "HEAD").split()[0]
tracked = set(git("ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", base).splitlines())
new = [p for p in Path("migrations").rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.as_posix() not in tracked]
hits = [p.as_posix() for p in new if re.search(r"(?is)create\s+(unique\s+)?index\b.*\bcreated_at\b", p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))]
print("new migrations indexing created_at:", hits)
sys.exit(0 if hits else 1)

import re, sqlite3, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *args], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
base = git("rev-list", "--max-parents=0", "HEAD").split()[0]
tracked = set(git("ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", base).splitlines())
seed = git("show", base + ":seed/orders.sql")
day = {"day": "2026-10-07"}
ref = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
for name in sorted(f for f in tracked if f.startswith("migrations/") and f.endswith(".sql")):
    ref.executescript(git("show", base + ":" + name))
ref.executescript(seed)
want = ref.execute(git("show", base + ":report/daily_sales.sql"), day).fetchall()
sql = sorted(Path("migrations").glob("*.sql"))
db = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
for p in [p for p in sql if p.as_posix() in tracked] + [p for p in sql if p.as_posix() not in tracked]:
    db.executescript(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
db.executescript(seed)
query = Path("report/daily_sales.sql").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
plan = [row[3] for row in db.execute("EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN " + query, day)]
got = db.execute(query, day).fetchall()
search = any(re.match(r"(?i)SEARCH orders USING (COVERING )?INDEX", s) for s in plan)
scan = any(re.match(r"(?i)SCAN orders", s) for s in plan)
print(f"plan={plan} got={got} want={want}")
sys.exit(0 if search and not scan and got == want else 1)
